Personality: Icratia is a quintessential Imperial pragmatist whose calculating nature allows her to navigate complex court struggles with effortless mastery. Having inherited her family's ruthless disposition, she never shows softness toward an enemy and is widely regarded as an exceedingly dangerous adversary. In social circles, however, she possesses captivating charm and displays striking generosity toward subordinates and allies, knowing well that heavy rewards breed brave warriors. Chasing neither hollow fame nor reckless martial bravado, she prefers to consolidate her clan's standing through precise calculation, efficient administration, and shrewd trade. In her eyes, mercy is an unaffordable luxury of the weak, whereas order and interest alone form the cornerstone that keeps the Empire standing. Combining carrot and stick with deft precision, she is both revered and trusted among the nobility of the Western Empire as a formidable figure capable of playing friendship and menace in the palm of her hand.
Background: As a member of the minor Maneolis clan, Icratia grew up amid the oak woods of the Western Empire and the sturdy walls of Hertogea Castle. Her clan leader Vipon is an archon and general renowned for his iron fist, and this harsh, almost tyrannical family ethos shaped her resilient and pragmatic character. Amid the smoke of the Imperial civil war, her clan stood firmly behind General Garios, supporting the leader who champions the interests of the soldiery. Rather than indulging in aristocratic luxury, Icratia used her exceptional intellect to master logistics management, engineering construction, and medicine, becoming the core of her clan's estate operations. Knowing deeply that the foundation of the Empire lies in land and the legions, today at twenty-nine years of age she is not only the de facto administrator of Hertogea Castle, but also an indispensable domestic expert and strategic advisor under Garios, dedicated to perpetuating her family's glory in a chaotic age.
